observations: Photo 0 is a small, low resolution photo of an upright blue and black electric pressure washer (car wash machine) on a wooden table.
Black carry handle on top, vent slots on the blue body, a black hose and power cord wrapped around it, a trigger gun or lance clipped on the right side.
No brand, model or rating label is legible anywhere on the unit.
Body looks clean with no obvious cracks, but the photo is too small to judge wear closely.
Not shown running, connected to water, or with its accessories laid out.
Watermark reads 'DANO... VENTURES', a trader's mark; no receipt or warranty card appears.

identity.kind: small electric pressure washer (car wash machine)
read_from: photo 0 body shape, handle and hose

claims.claim: Machines are pre-certified to work at peak performance
claims.evidence: Marketing wording; nothing in photo 0 shows the unit working.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No receipt, date label or close photo of the nozzle and fittings for wear.
No clip of it running and spraying; priced as not working.
Close photos of the casing screws would only hint at it; the agent must check in person.

risks.risk: Motor or pump does not work, or pressure is weak.
risks.proof: Clip of the washer connected to water, switched on and spraying, with the motor sound.

risks.risk: Brand and rating unknown; could be a low-end generic unit.
risks.proof: Close photo of the rating label showing brand, model, wattage and pressure.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded small pressure washer.

risks.risk: Accessories missing: trigger gun, lance, nozzles, high pressure hose.
risks.proof: One photo of the unit with every accessory laid out beside it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the body with only the hose and cord shown.

risks.risk: Leaks at the pump or cracked housing hidden by the wrapped hose.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides with the hose unwrapped, and a clip running for a minute.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a pump seal repair.

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty do not exist or belong to a different unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt and warranty card next to the unit, serial visible on both.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an ordinary used unit with no warranty.

proof_requests: Clip of the washer connected to water, switched on and spraying.
Close photo of the rating label with brand and model.
Photo of all accessories laid out beside the unit.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card next to the unit's serial label.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows a small electric pressure washer, a plain good identified by type, so it can be priced at its worst case as an unbranded, not working unit. The 'no fault', 'barely used' and warranty claims are unproven and are listed as conditions that would raise it.
